=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3298-3378 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_merge_lease_gate_multi`, a current holder returns `self` in merge mode without running `_merge_lease_paths_intersect` against the other live holders. Update-mode renewal also re-reads the holder's files and writes them (`_merge_lease_holder_paths_set "${gm_pr}" "${gm_own_paths:-*}"` then `_merge_lease_write_holders`) without any overlap check. A failed files read at renewal writes the holder as `*`.
  WHY: If a review-autofix push makes holder B also edit holder A's files, B renews and the record keeps two overlapping holders. Both then pass the merge gate as `self`, so one merge can make the other's combined-tree CI stale, which the lease exists to prevent. This contradicts plan step 5.3 (docs/plans/merge-lease-parallel-merges-plan.md line 305, "Merge mode checks against every live holder"). Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite said BLOCKER; the other four said MAJOR. The highest is used here.
- README.md:165 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLDERS` row says "0 gives 1 and above 5 gives 5". `_merge_lease_max_holders` only accepts `^[0-9]{1,3}$`, so a value of four or more digits (e.g. `1000`) falls back to 1 with a warning.
  WHY: An operator who sets `1000` expecting the maximum gets single-holder behaviour. `tests/test_merge_lease.py` `test_max_holders_validation` pins `("1234", "1", True)`.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2494-2514 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_max_holders` (line 2504) rejects integers longer than three digits before it applies the documented 1-5 clamp.
  WHY: A value such as `1000` falls back to 1 with a warning, though the README and the plan say values above 5 clamp to 5. An operator can lose parallel holders without realising why.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3311-3329 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In merge mode, the `pr_files_failed` fail-open for unreadable caller files runs only when at least one holder has non-`*` paths. When every holder is `*`, `gm_own_paths:-*` defaults to `*` and intersects with the first holder.
  WHY: The caller is labelled `ai:merge-lease-wait` with `reason=holder_shares_paths` instead of failing open, against the documented single-holder fail-open contract. minimax notes the single-holder branch at lines 3522-3529 behaves the same way.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3385-3386 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In update mode, a successful read that returns zero changed files leaves the path list empty, and it falls back to `*` via `[ -n "${gm_own_paths}" ] || gm_own_paths="*"`.
  WHY: When MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLDERS > 1, a zero-file PR intersects with every holder and cannot acquire the lease in update mode.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_gate_multi, merge-mode branch at the start of the function (`if [ "${gm_mode}" = "merge" ]; then if [ -n "${gm_own_row}" ]; then MERGE_LEASE_OUTCOME="self" ... return 0`), and the update-mode renewal branch (`gm_own_paths="$(_merge_lease_pr_paths "${gm_pr}" 2>/dev/null || true)"; _merge_lease_holder_paths_set "${gm_pr}" "${gm_own_paths:-*}"` followed by `_merge_lease_write_holders`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Overlap is checked only when a holder joins. Merge mode returns `self` without checking other holders, and renewal writes new paths without `_merge_lease_paths_intersect`. A failed read writes `*`, yet the holder still merges as `self`.
  WHY: When A (a.py) and B (b.py) hold and B's PR grows to edit a.py, both pass as `self`, can both arm auto-merge, and the second merges an untested combined tree. Phase 5 introduces this. The plan (docs/plans/merge-lease-parallel-merges-plan.md line 305) says "Merge mode checks against every live holder".
- README.md:the `MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLDERS` row ("0 gives 1 and above 5 gives 5"), compared with scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_merge_lease_max_holders` (`if ! [[ "${lease_mh_raw}" =~ ^[0-9]{1,3}$ ]]; then ... echo 1`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A value of four or more digits (e.g. `1000`) gets 1 and a "not an integer" warning, not 5. tests/test_merge_lease.py test_max_holders_validation pins `("1234", "1", True)`.
  WHY: An operator expecting the maximum gets single-holder behaviour.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Requirement: "Add an agents.d/merge-lease-parallel-p5-multi-holder.md fragment for the record-format and log contract."
  Expected change site: agents.d/merge-lease-parallel-p5-multi-holder.md, as a `<!-- agents: section="Stable log prefixes (contractual)" -->` block.
  Evidence of absence: The fragment has only an "Isolated Codex agents" block (line 1). Earlier phases did add such blocks (agents.d/merge-lease-parallel-p2-revocation.md line 8, merge-lease-parallel-p4-soft-paths.md line 8, merge-lease-final-ci-resume.md lines 7 and 11). None record `holders=<n>` or `outcome=skipped reason=holder_shares_paths blocker=`.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  Requirement: "Check `wc -c` of each edited workflow against the 480,000-byte guard (section 24)."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (+3 lines) and .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (+4 lines).
  Evidence of absence: No byte count is recorded, and tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py is marked "unmet" (inherited). Whether the guard is breached is unverified.
- HARDENING (2 related items) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
  - scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_merge_lease_gate_multi` renewal: on a failed read, keep the previous paths (`gm_own_paths="$(_merge_lease_holder_paths "${gm_pr}")"`). About 2 lines.
  - Merge-mode self branch: loop over the earlier rows in gm_row_arr with `_merge_lease_paths_intersect`, and call `_merge_lease_gate_multi_wait ... merge holder_shares_paths` on a hit. About 8 lines.
- Not reported, with the reviewer's reasons: "all holders `*`" and "empty own paths" behave the same as the single-holder path; `_merge_lease_cas_commit` chaining (lines 2822-2830) is correct; MAX_HOLDERS=1 keeps v1 behaviour; the env default of 1 is wired in all nine workflow env lines; a PR-controlled filename cannot forge a record line.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_gate_multi (lines 3298-3305, 3336-3357) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: In merge mode an existing holder returns "self" without checking that its files are still disjoint from other holders, and in update mode it renews without an overlap check.
  WHY: A holder whose PR grows to overlap another holder's files renews and merges, which makes the other holder's combined-tree CI stale.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_max_holders (lines 2494-2514) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The README says values above 5 clamp to 5, but the helper only accepts 1-3 digit integers and falls back to 1 with a warning.
  WHY: An operator can silently get a single holder.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_gate_multi (lines 3311-3329) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The merge-mode `pr_files_failed` fail-open runs only if some holder has non-`*` paths. When every holder is `*`, the caller waits on the first holder.
  WHY: The caller is labelled `ai:merge-lease-wait`, against the single-holder fail-open contract.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_gate_multi (lines 3385-3386) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: In update mode, a successful zero-file read becomes `*` and intersects with every holder.
  WHY: A zero-file PR cannot acquire the lease when MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLDERS > 1.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Requirement: "Add an agents.d/merge-lease-parallel-p5-multi-holder.md fragment for the record-format and log contract."
  Expected change site: agents.d/merge-lease-parallel-p5-multi-holder.md, with a block targeting Stable log prefixes (contractual).
  Evidence of absence: The fragment has only an "Isolated Codex agents" block. `holders=<n>` and `outcome=skipped reason=holder_shares_paths blocker=` are not in the registry.

  Requirement: "Check wc -c of each edited workflow against the 480,000-byte guard (section 24)."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml and .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml.

=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:lines 3299-3306 in `_merge_lease_gate_multi` (merge mode self branch) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A current holder returns "self" without checking overlap against the other live holders. The intersect loop (lines 3307-3337) runs only when `gm_own_row` is empty.
  WHY: When B grows to touch A's `a.py`, B returns `outcome=self reason=self` and merges, so A's CI goes stale. `test_merge_mode_checks_every_holder` (lines 1480-1482 of tests/test_merge_lease.py) does not exercise this case.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:lines 3343-3378 in `_merge_lease_gate_multi` (update-mode renewal branch) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Renewal writes the re-read paths via `_merge_lease_holder_paths_set` + `_merge_lease_write_holders` without an intersect check against other rows in `gm_row_arr`.
  WHY: The overlap is persisted, and both holders then return "self". A gh_retry failure also
